scope: Read-only review of exact uploaded scripts before submission; no EDA or live-file modification.
verified_design_of_gates: Only actually resized, non-DNT, non-macro cells become PLACED; non-resized longwire buffers and other standard cells retain temporary locks.
Original movement whitelist and die/BPin/macro geometry assertions remain active.
Master/location/orientation/pin signatures rip all connected changed signal nets, including input and output nets.
Each selected cumulative plan receives independent legalization, CUGR, strict pin access, detailed routing, actual extraction, GDS, and fresh timing/PG diagnostics.
The source ODB is hard-bound to b593; the same frozen source supplies SDC and configuration.
Original input and prepared hashes are rechecked before CANDIDATE-COMPLETE; that marker explicitly does not assert backend acceptance.
One-node exclusive steps allocate eight CPUs per selected case, with selected_count between one and six; preparations are not shared across distinct plans.
nonblocking_hardening: Freeze and hash u-fresh-spef-pg.tcl alongside other executed TCL files.
Recheck selection.sha256 at case completion to cover all original selector/catalog/receipt/planning-manifest dependencies across the complete execution window.
remaining_actual_gates: Every resulting candidate still requires actual native/full DRC, antenna, PG/material provenance, DEF/GDS/RCX correspondence, fresh all setup/hold/electrical checks, interface/X8 geometry, and strict actual netlist proof. A route/fresh process failure can produce diagnostics but cannot qualify a candidate.
